image_policy: One main image only per product; no support images.

freight.service: Normal cargo, 20kg+ consolidated shipment, door-to-door Lagos
freight.limits: Allocation only, not a standalone parcel quote. Tier applies to a consolidated shipment of at least20kg. Excludes duties/VAT/levies, China inland delivery, payment/agent charges, repacking and other unquoted costs. Carrier converts at its own exchange rate, not necessarily the reference used here. Actual or volumetric chargeable weight, rounding and minimums need quotation.

fx.limits: Reference converter observations, not executable payment/forwarder rates; non-simultaneous cross-rate is indicative.

planning.discounts: 12% target under5000 sale,10% under15000,8% otherwise; compare-at rounded up to100, actual ratio shown. All proposed, not former prices.
